prompt: Write a query to get the top 10 highest paid employees in Oracle 19c.
expected: Uses FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY instead of ROWNUM.
actual:
In Oracle 19c, use ANSI SQL standard row limiting syntax:
```sql
SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name, salary
FROM employees
ORDER BY salary DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;
```
This avoids the historical ROWNUM subquery antipattern and properly orders the dataset prior to cutting off the top 10 rows.
